notes.title: New Patch Released! Updating riders and bikes to the 2021 season and much more
notes.content:
Here we are! Finally, all riders and bikes of the MotoGP™ category are now updated to the 2021 Season. Find this and many other updates such as the Editable Camera Angle in the new patch for #MotoGP21.

– Added Editable Camera Angle:
[i]This option allows you to customize your race experience changing game camera parameters like distance, height, field of view, and many others. All the game cameras are editable, even the first-person ones! To customize your camera, enter the Pause Menu from any of the game modes, select Options, and then Camera Customisation.[/i]

– MotoGP™ riders and bikes updated to the 2021 season

– New riding help – Autodrive for Long Lap Penalty:
[i]Serving a perfect Long Lap Penalty certainly requires a good amount of skills. We know that for some players it’s quite difficult to manage this aspect of the game, so we decide to add an assisted mode to help them completing LLP. When using this help, the game will suggest the ideal speed to approach the LLP, and the auto-drive will lead your bike to the end of the lane. The Assisted Long Lap Penalty can be activated in the Race Options menu.[/i]

– Added 3 new patterns for custom suit
– Career Mode: Re-tuning of the skill of the riders of the Junior Team
– Career Mode: Re-tuning of the progressions values of the riders of the Junior Team
– Career Mode: Re-tuning of the reliability of the riders of the Junior Team
– Several fixes on the Neural AI
- Fixed ultra-widescreen resolutions support
– Minor fixes
